text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On my day off, I decided to visit an amusement park
for a change of pace, but――

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Mmh... Current location unknown!
Where is the map!?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
...Ohh, could it be?!
If it isn't Trainer <username>!
choice_data_list: Did you come here to play?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Nay! I am currently conducting an inspection!
You see—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Amusement parks are frequently used facilities for students to refresh themselves!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
And then... it hit me!
In the first place!
Why not just build an amusement park right inside the academy?!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Thus, I decided to inspect this amusement park
and use it as reference!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Cover the classic staples while adding Tracen's unique flair! Let's build the ultimate Tracen Land (tentative)!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. However—while my spirit was willing,
I am quite unfamiliar with such facilities!
I was wondering what to do, but—
choice_data_list: If you'd like, shall we look around together?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, that's reassuring!
I'd gladly take you up on that!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Mmh!? What in the world is that!?
There is a tiny steam train running through the amusement park!?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Hrm, quite the playful spirit!
Don't mind if I play along!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's... a march!
Is that the parade I've heard rumors about!?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Mmh... I would love to adopt that.
It could serve as great reference for the students,
especially for their concerts and――

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Well... better to see it first than worry about it! Let's follow them, Trainer <username>!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Aha, delightful, truly delightful!
Now I understand why students come here for a change of pace!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
—Whoops, self-reflection!
I must never forget that this is all for the students' sake!

text_block_list.name: Park Visitor A
text_block_list.text:
When you come here, you gotta ride that one, right?
The Dragon Twister Planet Coaster!
The one famous for being suuuper scary!

text_block_list.name: Park Visitor B
text_block_list.text: Looks like the line's empty right now! Let's go while we can!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph. From what you've said, that coaster must be this amusement park's main attraction.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
However... a thrill ride! And a high scare-rating one at that!
Hm-mmm...! Mmm, mmm-mmm...!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: ...Nay! It is precisely the scarier attractions whose psychological stress and potential hazards I must test with my own body!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: On my pride as Chairwoman, this scream machine... I must conquer it!
choice_data_list: Then on my pride as your Trainer, count me in too!
Then on my pride as your Trainer, count me in too!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
...Heh, you're a daredevil yourself, aren't you!
Then... let us board, together!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
And... if possible,
I request that you ride next to me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Blistering high speeds, sudden steep drops――it was far more thrilling than I could have ever imagined, but encouraged by Chairwoman Akikawa holding out beside me, I managed to endure it somehow――

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha!
Today was a truly meaningful inspection!
Thanks to it, my grand vision has expanded immensely!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
I swear I'll build the greatest amusement park ever!
Just you wait and see!
choice_data_list: This will make the ultimate resting spot for the students!
Strike while the iron is hot! Let's start construction tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! Forget everything for a moment and indulge in amusement
—then regain the vitality to chase your dreams once more!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: I'm already looking forward to seeing the students' smiles! Hahaha!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And while things were getting really lively—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: —You cannot.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Whaaat?!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
There is no way we have budget for that!
Just how much do you think that's going to cost?!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Nngh... If that's how it is, then fine! I'll just dip
into my own pocket money and――!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, you always do this...!
You're far too reckless with your money!
Today, I am finally giving you a piece of my mind――

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Scolded by Ms. Tazuna—my amusement park dreams vanished like bubbles into thin air...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Still, thanks to this incident,
I felt like I had grown a bit closer
to the person known as Chairwoman Akikawa.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
—Nay! If it's merely staking out territory on the planned construction site,
we can start that right this second!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
If strike while the iron is hot is the word,
then let us do it! Ourselves!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Indeed!
Follow my lead, Trainer <username>!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! We place a roller coaster right over on that far side!
The track will even be visible from the Academy windows!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Over on that side is the main boulevard for the parade!
Now, where should we launch the fireworks from――

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, laughing and frolicking together,
the two of them toured the academy, but――

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: —You cannot.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: With just a single word from Ms. Tazuna, I was utterly shot down...
